Verification.phoneHint: Enter a Korean mobile number starting with 010.
Verification.invalidPhone: Enter an 11-digit mobile number starting with 010.
Verification.numberDescription: Enter the mobile number you use.
Verification.privacyNote: Your number stays here. It isn't sent or saved.
Verification.messageDescription: Review and send the message yourself in Messages. Then return here.
Verification.configurationNote: A real recipient and one-time message will appear once the service is connected.
Verification.disconnected: Messages can't open until the receiving address is configured.
Verification.waitingDescription: Once connected, this screen will update automatically after your message arrives.
Verification.countdownLabel: Preview time remaining: {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}
Verification.waitingNote: This preview doesn't receive messages or verify numbers. Returning from Messages doesn't verify your number.
Verification.statusUnavailable: The verification server isn't connected yet. Use the screen tests below to preview a result.
Verification.successDescription: This is the phone verification success screen.
Verification.successPreview: Preview only · this number has not been verified.
Verification.expiredDescription: Prepare a new verification message and try again.
Verification.mismatchDescription: Send from the SIM for the number you entered. If you use dual SIM, check your outgoing line.
Verification.resultPreview: Preview only · not a real verification result.
Verification.previewBoundary: Preview · verification service disconnected · no messages sent
Verification.helpManual: Open this page on your phone. On unsupported devices, you would need to enter the recipient and message manually in Messages.
Verification.helpDevice: Opening Messages doesn't send anything automatically. Review the recipient and message, then send it yourself.
Verification.helpMms: This method uses carrier MMS sent to an email address. Sending an email from Mail cannot verify your phone number.
Verification.helpIphone: On iPhone, check MMS availability in Settings → Apps → Messages. iMessage (blue bubbles) cannot verify your number this way. Green bubbles can mean SMS, MMS or RCS, so they don't guarantee MMS.
Verification.helpLimitations: A website can't force MMS or turn off iMessage. Your carrier, plan or device may not support MMS to email recipients. If sending fails, check support rather than sending repeatedly.
Verification.modalDescription: Verify a Korean mobile number. Preview only; no messages are sent.

VerificationTrial.boundary: Local test only — no account or registration is granted. Live carrier verification is disabled.
VerificationTrial.numberDescription: Create a short-lived challenge for a Korean mobile number. This local trial is separate from registration.
VerificationTrial.privacy: The local backend processes keyed phone digests and challenge state. Raw phone numbers are not stored by the verifier. Zoho mailbox access may cover all concierge messages; only verify-alias messages are processed. Do not submit personal data during synthetic testing.
VerificationTrial.manual: On your phone, open Messages manually. Copy the recipient and body above, and send from the number you entered.
VerificationTrial.candidate: This link is a compatibility candidate, not guaranteed to open or prefill correctly. Check the recipient and body, or copy them into Messages manually. Nothing sends automatically.
VerificationTrial.mmsWarning: Email-address MMS may be unsupported by your carrier, phone, or messaging app. Carrier charges may apply. Physical device and carrier testing is still required.

state.pending: Waiting for a message. Copy the recipient and body exactly; delivery alone does not verify a phone.
state.review: Not verified. A message was received but trusted carrier evidence has not been established. Do not treat this as proof of phone ownership.
state.verified: Synthetic local test passed. This is not live phone verification and grants no account or registration.
state.consumed: This trial has already been used. It cannot be reused for registration.
state.cancelled: This trial was cancelled. Create a new challenge to try again.
state.expired: This trial expired. Create a new challenge; old messages will not verify it.

error.create: We could not create a trial challenge. Check the local server and try again; no verification was granted.
error.status: We could not check the current status. Automatic checks are paused. Try Check status again; do not assume verification succeeded.
error.cancel: We could not confirm cancellation. Try again or close the window; the challenge will still expire.
